revision: H-v6.1 balanced five-family multihead (port of ngch D-v6.1)
extends: frozen_parent (B, or a C level over B)
locked: parent Yes (correct, accepted and resolved in the parent scoring) is immutable
targets: every other question; all five heads run on each capsule holding a target

legacy_heads.full: fresh B capsule run -> conservative Yes/No repair
legacy_heads.baseline_polling: fresh A capsule run -> poll_1 (conservative) Yes/No repair
legacy_heads.full_aggressive: fresh B capsule run -> conservative -> aggressive Yes/No repair

reflection_heads.data_forensics: one Yes/No repair of the parent answer
reflection_heads.method_triangulation: one Yes/No repair of the parent answer

selection: reference_free: normalized-answer consensus (>=2) over the selector heads, else their fixed priority; sequential_yes_no (D-v6.2): submit unique head answers in order until Yes
feedback_payload: per-question yes/no only; parent scoring for the reflection heads, the sibling grader on each legacy head's frozen stage output otherwise
yes_lock: every repair stage copies Yes results byte-for-byte
retry: repair stages never retry; fresh B heads keep B's single policy-interruption retry
